body:
Independent check complete: all 87 POINT.json numeric leaves match the frozen inputs. Least SF 0.650411843680531 reproduces; continuous crimp/wrinkle balance is 0.650413022409815, a minor search-resolution difference. Vc=3.32888490740389, Kc=0.300400893336944 and unity gamma agree with the handbook weak-core branch, so all three kd levels agree. Hexcel Ec=76 MPa and GW=14 MPa are verified.

Fix the opening mass sentence: total mass is 95% of lift, payload reserve 5% (4644.97004267761 kg and 244.472107509348 kg). CR-1457 includes Vc=2 in the unity-gamma region; the card assigns equality to kd. Neither filed geometry lies at the endpoint.

Shared S200F source discrepancy: the cited grade table gives E=290 GPa, versus the inherited 303. With E alone substituted, fixed-geometry SF is 0.636308391376 and rebalanced SF 0.643084807693. The strength edition remains an NFI. All are fix proposals; owners and subsequent cards continue.

Together with rpt-1228-mainline014b-independent-check-1019, this completes the two requested independent checks. No programme acceptance or certification is claimed.

links.what: Both independently derived check reports filed; fixes are nonblocking NFIs. Owner and programme obligations are not closed.
Corrected standing to none: this completed check imposes no hold. Scientific artifact bytes are unchanged.
